***Hundreds of [[Texas Military Forces]] troops arrive at a [[United States Army Reserve]] [[military base]] near [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], ahead of a deployment to the city. [https://news.sky.com/story/hundreds-of-texan-national-guard-troops-arrive-at-army-base-near-chicago-13446750 (Sky News)]
